content:
samir (partnerships): ping 0NimbusCloud is pushing a marketplace announcement for next Monday 10:00 PT. their PR draft references our "Dedicated Rack SKU" and they attached a PO that lists 6 racks, but vendor's latest manifest shows only 3. this is a problem for the demo capacity. :grimacing:
tess (procurement): seriously? PO NMB-4521 says 6 reserved for our dedicated commit. who changed the manifest?
owen (logistics): vendor note: one transload at SEA yard flagged for inspection; manifest snapshot: ```PO: NMB-4521
manifest_racks_assigned: 3
container: YRD-9982
status: held by port inspection
eta_candidate: 2026-04-07```
mei (eng-runtime): runtime note: we can stitch demo traffic across fewer racks + hosted warm pool but perf profile will degrade and cost jumps. we'd need to label any demo as "preview" and show benchmark delta.
announce-bot: [check] marketplace-stock: dedicated-certified: 3 available (vendor manifest) ; dedicated-committed: 6 (procurement records) ; hosted-backup: 5 warm instances
ash (sales): Nimbus legal is insisting on the "Dedicated Rack SKU" phrasing in the headline. they will likely push for stronger copy. we should avoid promising specific inventory counts until manifests clear.
paula (legal): concur. don't use fixed counts or "guaranteed" language. propose wording: "Now available in preview on Nimbus Marketplace. Dedicated and private deployment options subject to provisioning."
tess (procurement): mitigation options: (1) ask vendor to reassign 3 racks from an upcoming manifest (fastest if they can reroute) (2) reallocate 2 racks from EU pool + 1 from backup hosted (requires routing override) (3) postpone the public announcement until manifest is reconciled.
owen (logistics): reroute cost estimate is +$28k and still depends on customs clearance windows. port inspection backlog might take 48-96 hours.
mei (eng-runtime): engineering can add a listing-specific routing override: ```routing_override: allow-hosted-backup:true
notes: will tag requests and expose latency delta in dashboard``` we can enable this in ~45m after infra sign-off. latency delta: +10-18% p95.
samir (partnerships): Nimbus wants an answer in 90 minutes. what's the lowest-risk path that keeps the announcement timeline?
tess (procurement): lowest risk to timeline is (2) hybrid: 2 EU racks + 1 hosted backup, plus conservative announcement copy. i'll coordinate with vendor to confirm EU spare availability.
ash (sales): i'll message Nimbus marketing: propose "listing goes live in preview with limited live demo capacity; full Dedicated availability will follow provisioning". that should be acceptable and keeps momentum.
paula (legal): approved. also add "subject to provisioning and final shipping manifests" line.
mei (eng-runtime): @eng-infra can you approve routing override for the Nimbus listing? we'll attach cost tags and tracing.
samir (partnerships): agreed plan: pick option 2 hybrid fallback, update public copy to preview messaging, and create playbook note. Actions: Tess -> confirm EU rack allocation, Mei -> request infra flag, Owen -> chase port inspection docs, Ash -> vendor comms + Nimbus message.
announce-bot: [action] A-4412 request-routing-override-for-nimbus by eng-infra due: 1748137199
samir (partnerships): thanks team. I'll draft the preview blurb and post once Tess confirms rack counts. trying to avoid a repeat of the last-minute scramble :sweat_smile:
